summary: Swipeable stacked-card deck, with siblings peeking out behind the front card.
overview: Next, Previous and GoTo ease every card to its position and scale for the new index, with the cards behind peeking out and shrinking. Drag-to-advance is deliberately not built in — wire a draggable or raw pointer delta on the front card to whichever method suits.
useCases: A card-based character or level selector.
An onboarding flow of stacked pages.
A deck of items the player flicks through.

params.tuning: How much each card behind shrinks. Small values read as a thick deck; large ones as a receding tunnel.
How far the cards behind stick out. Zero hides them entirely and the deck reads as a single card.

gotchas.title: Dragging is not included
gotchas.body: It exposes the methods and leaves the gesture to you, so it does not fight whatever input system you use.
